name: Ryoujoku Shimai Byoutou
source:
Erina and her sister work as nurses at a large hospital in order to save their sick mother. They don't have the required qualifications and are tricked into satisfying doctors and patients carnal desires.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
艾莉娜和妹妹为拯救患病母亲，在大医院担任护士。她们缺乏所需资格，被骗去满足医生与患者的肉欲。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
